answer: A sponsor acts as a bridge for a newcomer by locking a 90-credit bond on the wharf ledger with funding source. Each sponsor backs at most three per epoch, so the bond splits to 30 credits, never reused. Auditors freeze any nebula cluster sharing a funding source or sponsor chain; confirmed clusters burn all bonds. The kth fake needs a fresh slot and 30-credit share, with fees rising from 20 to 50 after 300 slots, so 1,000 fakes lock 71,000 credits. Rented sponsors fail: the ledger exposes the chain and burns the bond. An honest newcomer pays 50 credits once, bond refunded after a clean epoch.
